purpose: Minimal, auditable contract between Benji's controller and Bob's keeper for the single-sided LP buyback on Uniswap V4 (Base). One parent tranche, three on-chain actions (mint/burn/collect) + one realize (swap) for redistribute. Per-tranche EXIT POLICY decides what happens on full fill; redistribute spawns exactly ONE terminal child (one re-range hop max).
venue: Uniswap V4 on Base — singleton PoolManager + v4-periphery PositionManager (ERC-721 position). Pool = PoolKey{currency0, currency1, fee, tickSpacing, hooks} READ FROM THE TARGET POOL (not pinned). We never CALL a hook; but the deepest pool may HAVE one (the v1 RATSPEAK/WETH pool is a Bankr dynamic-fee hooked pool). Auditability goal is therefore 'prove the pool's hook cannot touch our LP' (no before/after add/remove-liquidity permissions, no delta-skim), NOT 'zero hook bytecode'. Concentrated-liquidity tick math is identical to V3 — the buyback formula is unchanged.
denomination: WETH-native. The pool is RATSPEAK/WETH so the QUOTE side is WETH (18-dec). All capital/proceeds amounts are WETH; all prices are WETH-per-RATSPEAK. USD is display-only in the calculator (converted via an ETH/USD price) and NEVER appears in intents/fills.
amounts: All token/WETH quantities are DECIMAL STRINGS in human units (e.g. "0.005", "1000000000") — 18-dec supplies are not float-safe. Prices (P_top/P_bot/spot) are numbers for display; ticks are authoritative for on-chain math.

target_v1.hook_safety: Bob recon: the Bankr hook has NO before/after add/remove-liquidity permissions and NO delta-skim — it cannot block, seize, or tax our LP position. Auditor #1 task: re-verify these hook permission flags on-chain before the first live mint.
target_v1.liquidity_note: ~$349k at recon (drifted down from ~$596k) — still the deep venue; re-check depth at mint time to size the position sensibly.
blockers: isolated signer + funding (ONLY remaining blocker — address + pool params now resolved)
target_v1.verify_onchain: use the EXISTING deep RATSPEAK/WETH pool — poolKey above is the real on-chain pool (hooked, dynamic fee, tickSpacing 200). Confirm currency sort (WETH first) + decimals (both 18) + re-verify hook permission flags.

trigger._purpose: Front the buyback with a limit sell via a 3rd-party (CoW Swap). On fill, the sale proceeds (quote) seed the buyback rungs. If absent, the user has already sold and provides the quote capital directly.
trigger.provider: "cowswap" · limit orders + solver routing (MEV-protected). Order routing/matching is NOT built in-house.
trigger.limit_price: number · WETH/token — the sell limit = top of the buyback range
trigger.on_fill: how the seed happens — TBD by the CoW-capability spike: (a) CoW post-settlement Hook seeds atomically, or (b) keeper watches the fill and then mints. Pick during the spike.
trigger._open: verify CoW Hooks support on Base + whether a hook can seed our v4 LP atomically or we watch-fill-then-seed.

rungs.n: int 1-50 · split the buyback range [P_bot, P_top] into N single-sided positions (equal-liquidity geometric tiling — the N caps/tokens sum EXACTLY to the single-position U and T).
rungs.per_rung: each rung is its own ERC-721 position with its own tokenId AND its own exit_policy — they fill independently as price descends. N=1 = today's single position.
rungs.band_j: rung j covers [p_j, p_{j-1}] with p_k = P_top·(P_bot/P_top)^(k/N); avg_j = geomean(band) = √(p_j·p_{j-1}).

exit_policy._dir: controller → keeper, per tranche (per RUNG when N>1)

_options.hold: leave the LP in place on full fill. WARNING: a plain single-sided LP OSCILLATES — it buys at the bottom then RE-SELLS on a bounce. Passive market-making, NOT a locked buyback.
_options.keep: burn-on-full-fill: pull the position once it is 100% RATSPEAK and hold the tokens. This is the clean one-way buyback (fill-and-stop). DEFAULT.
_options.redistribute: on full fill: burn → realize (swap tokens→WETH) → re-mint ONE child tranche re-centered at the fill price with the same width factor f. See `redistribute`.

redistribute.roll_pct: number 0-100 — % of the realized tranche value (WETH) rolled into the child; the rest is BANKED as WETH.
redistribute.child_exit_policy: "hold" | "keep" — TERMINAL. The child CANNOT redistribute again (one re-range hop max). child.new_top = parent fill price; child.new_bot = f^2 * child.new_top.

intent.id: string · idempotency key — keeper dedupes; retries never double-execute
intent.action: "mint" | "burn" | "collect" | "realize"  (keeper encodes mint/burn/collect as v4 PositionManager actions inside the unlock callback; `realize` = swap the filled tranche's RATSPEAK→WETH, only used by redistribute before the child mint)
intent.exit_policy: "hold" | "keep" | "redistribute" · attached to a mint — tells the keeper what to do when THIS position fully fills
intent.redistribute: object · present iff exit_policy = redistribute → { roll_pct, child_exit_policy }

poolkey.currency0: string · lower-sorted token address = WETH 0x4200…0006 (address(0) if native ETH is used instead)
poolkey.fee: int · READ from the target pool — may be a static tier (10000=1% | 20000=2%) OR the dynamic-fee flag 0x800000 (RATSPEAK/WETH is dynamic). The keeper does NOT set it; it inherits the pool's.
poolkey.tickSpacing: int · EXPLICIT in v4, read from the pool (RATSPEAK/WETH = 200)
poolkey.hooks: string · READ from the target pool — may be non-zero (RATSPEAK/WETH = 0xBDF9…6544 Bankr). We never call it; verify it can't touch LP (see hook_safety).

intent.P_top: number · upper bound = current spot, WETH/token (mint only)
intent.weth: decimal string · WETH to deposit (mint only)

fill_report.mode: "LIVE" | "SIMULATED" · controller books LIVE only; SIMULATED is a dry-run for wiring/tests
fill_report.child_position_id: string · tokenId of the child tranche (rerolled only)
fill_report.rolled_weth: decimal string · WETH re-deployed into the child (rerolled only)
fill_report.banked_weth: decimal string · WETH kept out (rerolled only)

state_graph: PLANNED → OPEN(minted) → CONVERTING → FILLED(100% RATSPEAK) → { keep: HELD | hold: LP(oscillating) | redistribute: REALIZED → REROLLED → child FILLED → { keep: HELD | hold: LP } }. Terminal states: HELD, LP. The child never re-enters REROLLED (one hop).
conventions: PRICE ORIENTATION (critical): ALL prices in intents, fill_reports, and audit blocks are WETH-per-RATSPEAK (human 'WETH/token', e.g. 0.00000001), regardless of on-chain currency0/1 sort. With WETH as currency0 the raw pool price is RATSPEAK-per-WETH (inverted) and the buyback is a range ABOVE the pool tick — the keeper handles that inversion and reports realized_P_top/P_bot back in WETH-per-token so the controller's geomean/avg-fill math stays correct. Never mix pool-orientation and human-orientation prices.

USE THE EXISTING DEEP POOL: mint into the real ~$596k RATSPEAK/WETH pool at its actual fee tier. Do NOT initialize a fresh 1%/2% pool — that fragments liquidity into a thin venue with a bad reference price. Fee tier is configurable for productization, but round one INHERITS the live pool's tier.
Single-sided mint: deposit WETH only, range entirely below spot in WETH/token terms (P_top = spot). At the bottom it's 100% RATSPEAK = buyback filled.

REDISTRIBUTE needs a REALIZE step: after a fill the tranche is 100% RATSPEAK, not WETH. To re-range you must first swap RATSPEAK→WETH (`realize`), then mint the child with rolled_weth. This is the ONE keeper primitive beyond v1's mint/burn/collect. banked_weth = realized − rolled.
in/out are wallet-perspective: weth_in spent, token_out received. PnL reconstructed purely from fill_reports with integer/decimal math.

Controller trusts realized_P_bot/P_top from the keeper (v4 sorts currencies + resolves decimals on-chain, reports back in WETH/token orientation) — does not recompute price from raw ticks. Realized bounds are WIDER than clean bounds by the tickSpacing snap. Expected, not a bug.
Controller holds NO keys — keeper owns a dedicated isolated signer. v4 approvals go through Permit2 (keeper-internal). Flash-accounting settle/take handled inside the keeper's unlock callback.
No emissions (Uni V4, no gauge): realized PnL = matched spread + LP fees − gas, all in WETH. Optional USD view = PnL_weth × ETH/USD (display only).
One re-range hop MAX in v1.5: exit_policy=redistribute yields a child whose policy ∈ {hold, keep} only. Deeper ladders are a later multi-tranche module and would extend — not change — this contract.
